svg.text: MFC - CAP BOX
Rev M - GLUELESS, STEP 60 mm, LID HINGE AT THE STEP END, LONG TONGUE FROM THE INNER LIP
Material: E-flute litho-laminated board, caliper ~1.5 mm
Scale 1:1 - units mm - view from OUTSIDE (print side)
All creases fold away from viewer
Closed box (outside approx.): 218.2 W x 233.6 D x 199 H (same as Rev H)
Clear inside (between liners): 206 W x 226 D x 196 H (Rev C insert fits)
Sheet size: 725.5 x 910.6
Side seam gap: 4.9 mm square to the seam (as Rev H)
CHANGE vs Rev H (orange dashed outline):
10. The side split no longer starts in the back top corner.
Base side wall keeps full height 196 for 60 mm from the back,
then slopes 45.6 deg down to the front (front lip unchanged).
The base now hides the Rev C insert (top front corner ~53 mm
from the back at ~197 mm) when the lid is open.
11. Lid side ends 65.3 mm from the hinge; lid top is cut free
over the step. Lid front, lid ears unchanged.
12. Side liners, lid liners and lid ears re-mirrored about the
new 180 fold lines; liner tabs still land in the same 6 slots.
13. Base front height at the seam 26.4 (was 33.6).
14. Rev J: the top is split by a crease 65.3 mm from the back (where
the lid side starts). The back part is a FIXED TOP over the step;
the lid hinges on that crease, so the lid side turns about its
own tip and stays on the base step when the lid opens.
15. Fixed top has 2 side lock flaps (28 mm) that drop inside the
side walls over the step and hold it without glue.
16. Rev K: fixed top at full outside width (as the lid front) with a
180 hem on each side: smooth fold on the corner over the step,
the hem covers the raw top edges of the side walls; the lock
flap drops inside from the hem (hem 4.2 mm, lock 28 mm).
17. Lid front 167.8 mm (was 161.7): it stops 1 mm above the front lip,
one clean line at the front; base diagonal ends behind the lip
(26.4), so no open notch at the front corner.
18. Rev M: no tuck flap on the lid, no thumb cut: the front is plain.
The inner lip has a window; the tongue inside it (196 x 15 mm)
hinges at its top (double crease) and folds 180 UP behind the inner
lip, standing 10 mm above the front lip. The lid front and its
inner front hem close OUTSIDE over it like a lid over a collar.
NOTES - NO GLUE ANYWHERE (as Rev H)
1. Back and front lip fold up from BOTTOM.
2. Side-wall ears fold in; side walls go up, ears sit BEHIND the
front lip. Inner lip folds 180 down over them, tabs into slots;
then fold the TONGUE in the inner lip 180 UP so it stands behind it.
3. Back ears fold in; side LINER folds 180 over the slope edge,
covers them, 2 tabs push into the bottom slots.
4. Fixed top folds over the step, its 2 lock flaps drop inside the side walls;
the lid hinges on the crease at the front edge of the fixed top.
5. Lid front down, lid sides down, lid liners 180 over the slope
edge; their ears go in BEHIND the lid front.
6. Lid inner front folds 180 up and traps those ears;
on closing the lid front + hem go down OUTSIDE the base tongue.
7. Draft for white sample - printer to confirm crease and slot
allowances for their board before die.
8. E-flute: run flutes parallel to the long side folds.
Rev M - glueless - generated from Rev H geometry
LEGEND
Cut (incl. 6 lock slots in bottom)
Crease / fold
Double crease 2 mm apart (180 folds)
Bleed +3 mm for artwork
